titulo: GTA 6 And These Other Games Can Justify An $80 Price, Expert Says
texto: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases on November 19, and you'll have to pay at least $80 for it. That's a full $20 more than what GTA 5 cost in 2013 and $10 more than many other big AAA games today. Is $80 going to become the "new normal" for AAA games, or is it, along with Nintendo's Mario Kart World and Tears of the Kingdom for Switch 2 , an outlier at $80? According to Alinea Analytics researcher Rhys Elliott , $80 won't be an across-the-board new price for all games. Some developers will purposefully price their games lower to draw in more consumers--he pointed to games like Expedition 33 ($50), Phantom Blade Zero ($60), and Oblivion Remastered ($50) as examples. A scene from GTA 6. titulo: GTA 6 In-Game TV Show Macca & Friends Looks Ridiculous In The Best Way
texto: Rockstar Games has released the first footage of an in-game GTA 6 TV show called "Macca & Friends," which is about a sunglass-wearing pink alligator and his wetland friends in Leonida (the stand-in for Florida). One of Macca's friends is Pinchie the crab, who is Macca's landlord. Macca is also friends with a hat-wearing manatee and a flamingo. Check out the trailer below, which sets up a story where Macca needs to get money to pay his landlord. The story involves the group seemingly posing as cops and sneaking into a police station, maybe to grab some cash from an evidence locker? Macca & Friends will be available to watch on Weazel, which is GTA's version of Fox. For now, all we have is this teaser. titulo: Xbox Says Putting Ads In Games, Something No One Likes, Could Help Save Gaming
texto: Xbox Cloud Gaming now has a free ad-supported version that's rolling out as part of Microsoft's bigger push to bring more ads to Xbox. Jonathan Stringfield, who worked on Activision's advertising push and is now doing some of the same work in his title as GM for Xbox Media Solutions, said in an interview that people shouldn't see this as a move by Xbox to cram ads into all of its games. “There is zero world where there is intention--written, explicit, implicit, or otherwise--that ads will be an option in all games. It might not even be the case on all features of the console, et cetera,” he told GamesBeat . “Where we want to have these integrated is places where it makes sense--where it can actually provide value in a positive way. titulo: GTA 6 Passes 12 Million Copies Sold And $1.2 Billion In Revenue, And The Game Isn’t Even Out Yet
texto: The video game research company Sensor Tower has updated its GTA 6 sales tracker to reveal the latest, albeit unofficial, sales data for the open-world crime game. According to Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has now sold 12.13 million total units via pre-purchases, which works out to about $1.18 billion in gross revenue. The report said PS5 sales are dominating the mix, with GTA 6 selling 9.08 million units on PS5 so far, compared to 3.06 million on Xbox Series X|S. That means of the 12.13 million GTA 6 sales so far, 75% are on PS5 and 25% on Xbox Series X|S. In total, GTA 6 sales for PS5 have so far reached $880 million in revenue, compared to $296 million for Xbox Series X|S. titulo: The Xbox 25th Anniversary Console Restock Sold Out Before You Could Finish Reading This Headline
texto: After quickly selling out earlier this year, Microsoft dropped a limited number of its 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X consoles for sale this week-- aaaaannnd they're already gone . Easily the best-looking Xbox Series X console thanks to its transparent green case, it looks like the majority of people looking to get one of these are out of luck, unless they're willing to pony up and pay extra for one of these consoles on sites like eBay, where they're currently being listed at next-gen console prices. Naturally, fans who missed out are livid, and online, they're calling out Xbox's first-come first-serve business model for selling the console, as opposed to a method like a lottery system that would even the playing field.
